# B2B Lead Growth

> B2B Lead Growth is a founder-run commercial HVAC managed outbound service for ESTABLISHED
> HVAC contractors that already sell and complete commercial work. It finds the commercial
> accounts worth pursuing, contacts the right people in the contractor's name, and hands each
> opportunity to the contractor's team at one of three levels of responsibility: Prospecting
> ($750/mo), Managed Pipeline ($1,500/mo), or Qualified Opportunity Engine ($2,500/mo). The
> HVAC contractor always estimates and closes. It is a monthly service, not a lead seller: no
> leads are sold, resold, or brokered, and nothing is priced per lead or per opportunity.
> Homeowners are never contacted. It started in 2026 and has no clients, reviews, case studies,
> or results to publish yet, and publishes none; it never guarantees revenue, contracts,
> appointments, site visits, qualified opportunities, or any count of them.

Last updated: 2026-09-17

This file is a plain summary for language models. It is not the site's search strategy: every
fact below is published, in full and with its reasoning, on the pages listed at the end.

## What this is

- Category: commercial HVAC managed outbound, also called commercial HVAC lead generation.
- A monthly service for established HVAC contractors with commercial work. One niche.
- Everyone it contacts is a business: property and facility managers, building owners, multi-site operators, and the people responsible for HVAC at offices, warehouses, schools, healthcare sites, restaurants and retail.
- Not a lead seller, not a residential lead marketplace, not a PPC agency, not a directory, not a call center, and not an outsourced closer.
- Founder-run, based in New Jersey, and delivered remotely for HVAC contractors anywhere in the United States.

## Who it is for, and who it is not for

- For: an established HVAC contractor that already sells and completes commercial work, has someone who quotes and wins those bids, has room to take on more accounts, and has no consistent way to find target accounts and follow up with them.
- Not for: residential-only shops (there is no commercial account base to build from, and homeowners are never contacted); anyone wanting to buy homeowner leads; companies at capacity year-round; companies already running an in-house outbound or BDR team; solo operators; companies with nobody to quote and win commercial work; anyone expecting guaranteed jobs, revenue, site visits, or a set number of appointments.

## The three plans: three levels of responsibility, not three sizes

- Prospecting, $750 per month: "We find and contact suitable commercial accounts. You take over at interest." B2B Lead Growth owns targeting, research, contact selection, initial outreach, and identification of genuine interest, then hands the interested prospect to the contractor. Every message is a first touch.
- Managed Pipeline, $1,500 per month: "We run outreach and follow-up, screen genuine interest, and organize the handoff." B2B Lead Growth owns targeting, outreach, follow-up, interest screening, conversation organization, pipeline organization, and a structured handoff. What it hands over is screened interest.
- Qualified Opportunity Engine, $2,500 per month: "We qualify the opportunity, gather the relevant context, coordinate the next step or site visit, and prepare your team to estimate and close." B2B Lead Growth owns everything above plus qualification against a published standard, useful property, buyer and scope context, next-step coordination, site-visit coordination where appropriate, and a prepared opportunity handoff.
- A lower plan never includes a higher plan's work. No account is forced through the top plan's workflow.
- Capacity limits are supporting facts, never the reason a plan costs more: up to 40 first-touch messages a month, up to 100 outreach messages a month, and up to 150 outreach messages a month, in plan order.
- Terms: flat monthly price, no setup fee, no per-lead charge, no per-opportunity fee, no acceptance fee, no commission, month-to-month, 14 days' notice to cancel either side. No pilot and no free trial of a paid plan.

## The boundary, on every plan

- B2B Lead Growth prepares the opportunity. The HVAC contractor estimates and closes it.
- B2B Lead Growth does not perform technical HVAC inspections, engineer solutions or specify equipment, diagnose equipment, determine final project scope, create binding HVAC estimates or quotes, set final pricing, negotiate technical or contract terms, guarantee contracts, or replace the contractor's estimator or salesperson in closing.

## Terminology (never interchangeable)

- Prospect: a commercial account, or a contact at one, that matches the approved targeting requirements. Always a business, never a homeowner.
- Interested Prospect: a relevant contact expressing genuine openness to continuing the conversation, confirmed by a person rather than a keyword match.
- Screened Interest: an interested prospect whose basic relevance and intent have been checked. The unit the $1,500 Managed Pipeline hands off.
- Qualified Opportunity: a commercial opportunity meeting the defined qualification standard, with sufficient verified business, buyer, scope and next-step context to justify the contractor investing sales or estimating time. Reserved for the $2,500 Qualified Opportunity Engine.
- Structured Handoff: the organized transfer of the conversation, the relevant context, the history and the next action to the HVAC contractor.
- The one activity metric is interested prospects, always shown against accounts contacted and outreach messages sent. It is a count of what happened, never a commitment to a number.

## How the outreach runs

- Accounts are researched from free public sources. Every account carries a named contact, a cited reason it was picked, and a public source link. An account with no citation cannot be contacted.
- Outreach sends from the contractor's own domain and mailbox, in the contractor's name, after the contractor has signed off the account categories, service area, exclusions, permitted claims and sending identity.
- Sending starts deliberately slowly: 1 message a day, then 2, 5 and 10, then full volume from about day 6. Opt-outs are suppressed immediately, in code, permanently.
- Cold outreach is email-led. There are no cold calls on any plan. A call becomes appropriate only after a contact has shown genuine interest; on Qualified Opportunity Engine the service can run an engaged call under the contractor's written authorization.
- Homeowners are NEVER researched, bought, inferred, or contacted, on anyone's behalf.

## How someone starts

- The single entry point is the fit check at https://www.b2bleadgrowth.com/start. It returns a straight yes or no on fit and suggests a plan from the answers.
- It screens out companies the service cannot help (residential-only, wanting to buy homeowner leads, at capacity, already running an in-house outbound seat) rather than booking them a call.
- The entry offer is the Free Pipeline Audit: an account profile, 3-5 individually vetted and cited commercial accounts, one sample outreach message, and a read on where the contractor's commercial work comes from today.
- The audit is free and kept regardless of whether the recipient becomes a client. It is delivered IN WRITING; a call is never its price, though a walkthrough is offered afterwards. Nothing is sent to anyone as part of it, and it contains no homeowner records.
